records.title: A Survey on Performance Modeling and Prediction for Distributed DNN Training
records.reason: 一次出版社ページ https://doi.org/10.1109/TPDS.2024.3476390 を開いたが、読める要旨/本文を取得できず、入力要旨だけで対象外とは判定しない。一次証拠を照合できないためborderline。

records.title: An exploration of prompting LLMs to generate energy-efficient code
records.reason: The measured energy is that of code generated by LLMs, not energy/resource use of LLM inference; prompt effects are inconsistent across tasks.

records.title: Learning to Achieve Goals with Belief State Transformers
records.reason: Bidirectional prefix/suffix objective and compact belief states are evaluated on small synthetic goal-reaching tasks. Decoding is discussed but no LLM-serving latency, memory, or throughput optimization is established.

records.title: Adventurer: Optimizing Vision Mamba Architecture Designs for Efficiency
records.reason: Adventurer is a vision-only Mamba architecture reporting ImageNet training throughput/accuracy, not language-model inference serving.

records.title: Plug-and-Play Controllable Generation for Discrete Masked Models
records.reason: Importance sampling controls discrete masked-model generation without conditional-score training. Full text emphasizes posterior sampling, inverse problems and protein design, not LLM inference cost or latency.
